home.title: Together We Made Power
home.description: We are a team of caring individuals united by a common goal – supporting the Ukrainian people, especially during this difficult time for our country. Our mission is to unite resources and efforts of people from all over the world to effectively counter the challenges of war in various areas. While our defenders are fighting for their homeland on the front lines, we are building a strong and reliable rear for our people, providing the necessary assistance and support.

karina.name: Karina
karina.description: The head of the foundation actively works on fulfilling the organization's mission, inspiring the team, and supporting projects that change lives.

dmitry.name: Dmitry
dmitry.description: The deputy head assists in the strategic management of the foundation, supporting key initiatives and ensuring their successful implementation.

artur.name: Artur
artur.description: The project manager coordinates fundraising and foundation initiatives, making them more effective and impactful.

svitlana.name: Svitlana
svitlana.description: The foundation manager organizes workflows to ensure every task is completed efficiently and on time.

alexandra.name: Alexandra
alexandra.description: Oversees and coordinates all charity initiatives, ensuring smooth execution and alignment with the foundation’s mission.

lubov.name: Lubov
lubov.description: Manages volunteer activities, recruits new members, and ensures everyone is engaged in meaningful work.

volodimyr.name: Volodymyr
volodimyr.description: Organizes transportation and distribution of aid, ensuring supplies reach those in need efficiently.

danil.name: Danil
danil.description: Develops and implements fundraising strategies to secure financial support for the foundation’s projects.

andrey.name: Andrey
andrey.description: Manages public relations, social media, and outreach efforts to raise awareness and support for the foundation.

alevtyna.name: Alevtyna
alevtyna.description: Builds relationships with local communities, ensuring their needs are met and fostering strong support networks.

olha.name: Olha
olha.description: Develops partnerships with communities and initiates joint projects that meet their needs.

ivan.name: Ivan
ivan.description: Handles communication with the public and supports the organization’s positive image across various media.

projects.title: Our projects
projects.description: Explore our ongoing and past projects dedicated to making a difference.
projects.event_cta: Follow our journey and see the impact of your support on Instagram @twmp.foundation!

Grooming.alt: The fund's volunteers in a group photo next to a TWMP banner
Grooming.title: Grooming
Grooming.description: Supporting vulnerable communities with essential grooming supplies.

post-text.event_description: This campaign provides grooming kits to vulnerable individuals, helping restore dignity and confidence.
event_highlights: Distributed grooming kits to 500 individuals.
Supported 20 shelters with hygiene supplies.
event_effects: Restored dignity to individuals in crisis.
Improved hygiene for vulnerable communities.
post-text.event_thanks: Thank you for your support in empowering communities!

MaternityAid.alt: Volunteers unload a van and hand a baby stroller to mothers outside a building
MaternityAid.title: Aid for Mothers and Children in the Kyiv Region
MaternityAid.description: Support for pregnant women and children in the Kyiv region.

post-text.event_title: Humanitarian Aid for Mothers and Children
post-text.event_description: We organized the provision of diapers and baby food for pregnant women and their children in the Kyiv region.
event_highlights: Distributed diapers to families with young children.
Provided baby food for pregnant women and infants.
event_effects: Supported families with children in crisis situations.
Improved the quality of life for young mothers.
post-text.event_thanks: Thank you to everyone who contributed to this initiative. Together, we are strong!

RelocationAid.alt: Volunteers hand out boxes of clothes and shoes to displaced women and children
RelocationAid.title: New Clothes and Shoes: Aid for Displaced Persons
RelocationAid.description: Providing humanitarian assistance to ≈250 displaced persons, including ≈50 children, who lost their homes.

post-text.event_title: Supporting Displaced Persons in Temporary Housing
post-text.event_description: We organized a trip to a temporary housing area for ≈250 displaced persons from various hotspots who lost their homes. Among them were ≈50 children. We provided essential aid to improve their living conditions.
event_highlights: Provided food for all displaced persons.
Supplied personal hygiene items.
Delivered clothing for children and adults.
Ensured access to necessary medications.
Gifted toys to bring joy to children.
Provided children’s furniture and strollers to enhance living conditions.
event_effects: Improved living conditions for ≈250 displaced persons.
Brought support and care to ≈50 children.
Supported communities in crisis.
post-text.event_thanks: We extend our gratitude to everyone who supported our efforts and all partners who made this project possible. Together, we are strong!

LargeRelocationAid.alt: Displaced families, many with small children, queue for food at a distribution point in Skvyra
LargeRelocationAid.title: Food Distribution in Skvyra: Aid for Displaced Persons
LargeRelocationAid.description: Providing humanitarian assistance to ≈1000 displaced persons, including ≈200 children, who lost their homes.

post-text.event_title: Supporting Displaced Persons in Temporary Housing
post-text.event_description: We organized a trip to a temporary housing area for ≈1000 displaced persons from various hotspots who lost their homes. Among them were ≈200 children. We provided essential aid to improve their living conditions.
event_highlights: Provided food for all displaced persons.
Supplied personal hygiene items.
Delivered clothing for children and adults.
Ensured access to necessary medications.
Gifted toys to bring joy to children.
Provided children’s furniture and strollers to enhance living conditions.
event_effects: Improved living conditions for ≈1000 displaced persons.
Brought support and care to ≈200 children.
Delivered large-scale humanitarian aid effectively.
post-text.event_thanks: We extend our gratitude to everyone who supported this project and helped make it a reality. Together, we are strong!

GastroFamilyAid.alt: Takeaway boxes of hot meals with chicken and vegetables lined up on a counter
GastroFamilyAid.title: Support from Gastro Family
GastroFamilyAid.description: The incredible Gastro Family restaurant network has been aiding hospitals, the military, and civilians since the early days of the war.

post-text.event_title: Delicious Meals Made with Love by Gastro Family
post-text.event_description: Since the third day of the war, the Gastro Family restaurant network has been providing hospitals and the military with fresh, hot meals and sweet drinks daily. They also prepared meals for civilians and children, bringing joy and support.
event_highlights: Daily provision of hot meals for hospitals and the military.
Preparation of meals and desserts for civilians and children.
Care and love in every dish.
event_effects: Supported hospitals and the military with hot meals during difficult times.
Brought joy to children through delicious meals and desserts.
Strengthened community spirit through care and collaboration.
post-text.event_thanks: We extend heartfelt thanks to @dmytro_borisov and @lena_borysova and their professional team for their humanity, support, and trust. Together, we are strong!

MedicalAid.alt: A donation box with the fund's logo next to a Keren for Our Child banner asking to help children with cancer
MedicalAid.title: Aid for Medical Equipment
MedicalAid.description: Fundraising for the purchase of an Evroklav23VS+ sterilizer for children with cancer.

post-text.event_description: Thanks to joint efforts, we raised 19,000 UAH, which was transferred to our partner, the Keren for Our Child Foundation, for purchasing an Evroklav23VS+ sterilizer worth 130,000 UAH. This is an important step in supporting children with cancer.
event_highlights: Raised 19,000 UAH for medical equipment.
Partnered with @endorphin__music, who donated 50% of ticket sales.
Received 20% of profits from @estetikakyiv for supporting children.
event_effects: Supported the purchase of equipment for treating children with cancer.
Engaged partners in charitable activities.
United the community around a common goal.
post-text.event_thanks: A heartfelt thanks to partners @endorphin__music, @estetikakyiv, and all participants who joined this charitable initiative. Together, we are strong!

MilitarySupport.alt: Two soldiers in new winter jackets hold the fund's logo next to bags of supplies
MilitarySupport.title: Support for the Military
MilitarySupport.description: Financial support for the military through partners and friends.

post-text.event_description: Thanks to the financial support of IT company @allstarsitcom, we raised 111,600 UAH to provide Ukrainian military personnel with essential equipment and clothing.
event_highlights: Delivered 10 wood-burning stoves to the military.
Purchased 4 backup battery units.
Provided 25 winter jackets for defenders.
event_effects: Improved conditions for soldiers during the winter period.
Equipped the military with warm clothing and essential gear.
Strengthened support through collaborative partnerships.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to @allstarsitcom for their financial aid and @nezalezhna.foundation for organizing the delivery of support. Together, we are strong!

AnimalShelterSupport.alt: Pet carriers and boxes of food delivered to a room at an animal shelter
AnimalShelterSupport.title: Support for Animal Shelters
AnimalShelterSupport.description: Providing shelters with food, canned goods, and essential resources for cats and dogs.

post-text.event_description: Our foundation actively supports animal shelters by providing them with food, canned goods, and other essential resources. Through collaboration with @dtp.kiev.ua, we identified shelters in need and delivered support directly to them.
event_highlights: Assisted more than 10 animal shelters.
Supported shelters like @sirius.shelter, @zveropolis.kiev, @rudiy_kit, @happy_animals_city, and others.
Delivered food, canned goods, and other necessary supplies.
event_effects: Improved living conditions for animals in shelters.
Provided essential resources for animal care.
Engaged the community to support our furry friends.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to @dtp.kiev.ua for assisting in identifying shelters and organizing aid delivery. Together, we are strong!

SupportForChildren.alt: Open boxes packed with baby food, diapers and hygiene items for children
SupportForChildren.title: Support for Children with Disabilities and Orphans
SupportForChildren.description: Providing assistance to children with disabilities and orphans under 18.

post-text.event_title: Support for Children with Disabilities and Orphans
post-text.event_description: Our foundation provides support to children under 18 with disabilities and orphans. We are committed to ensuring they receive the help they need.
event_highlights: Provided assistance to children with disabilities.
Supported orphans under 18 years old.
Fast delivery of humanitarian aid thanks to @novaposhta_humanitarian.
event_effects: Families with children were supplied with essential items.
Provided support to the most vulnerable groups.
Improved the quality of life for orphans and children with disabilities.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to @novaposhta_humanitarian for their swift delivery of supplies. Together, we are strong!

GiftCampaign.alt: Rows of paper gift bags with toys and sweets ready for children
GiftCampaign.title: Gifts for Children
GiftCampaign.description: Gift packages for children provided by our partners.

post-text.event_description: We organized gifts for children to bring them happiness and joy during challenging times. The gifts were made possible thanks to the support of our partners.
event_highlights: Ball by @lux_groups_ua.
Badminton set by @lux_groups_ua.
Catchball by @lux_groups_ua.
Mortal Kombat toy by @kiwi_party_.
Waffles by @kyivbkk.
Kinder chocolate by @auchanukraine.
Sweet gingerbread by @lux_groups_ua.
Drawing album by @lux_groups_ua.
Nike banana bag by @charityfoundation_ua.
Markers by @lux_groups_ua.
Cookies by @lux_groups_ua.
Sticker pack by @lux_groups_ua.
event_effects: Over 100 gift sets distributed to children.
Brought joy and smiles to children.
Engaged partners to support the campaign.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to our partners: @lux_groups_ua, @kiwi_party_, @kyivbkk, @auchanukraine, @charityfoundation_ua. Together, we are strong! 💛💙

InternatSupport.alt: Children and staff at a residential home open gift boxes brought by a volunteer
InternatSupport.title: Support for a Children's Residential Home
InternatSupport.description: Assistance for children with special needs, orphans, and those affected by war.

post-text.event_title: Support for a Children's Residential Home in Difficult Times
post-text.event_description: In January, our team visited a children's residential home that houses children with special needs, orphans, and those affected by war. We delivered essential aid and brought joy to the children.
event_highlights: Provided a generator for heat and electricity.
Delivered warm clothing sets and footwear for the children.
Donated blankets for comfort.
Prepared and distributed treats for the children.
event_effects: Improved living conditions in the children's residential home.
Brought joy and support to children during difficult times.
Raised awareness about the needs of children's residential homes in Ukraine.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to our sponsor @stelp_supporter_on_site for their assistance and trust in our foundation. Together, we are strong! 💙💛

CharityBrunch.alt: Guests of the charity brunch pose together in a decorated restaurant hall
CharityBrunch.title: Charity Brunch
CharityBrunch.description: Funds raised to support families with infants who lost their homes.

post-text.event_description: We are grateful to the brunch organizers for their initiative, which raised 10,000 UAH to support three families with infants who lost their homes in Kharkiv, Mariupol, and Severodonetsk.
event_highlights: Raised 10,000 UAH for charity.
Provided aid to three families with infants.
Gifted baby kits to families in Kharkiv, Mariupol, and Severodonetsk.
event_effects: Provided essential support to children and their families.
United efforts for greater charity effectiveness.
Built trust and made a positive impact on charitable initiatives.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to @iryna__kholodova, @viktoriya_yanochkina for organizing the brunch and to every participant for their contribution. Together, we are strong! 💙💛

HospitalSupport.alt: Hospital staff holding the fund's logo stand beside boxes of delivered supplies
HospitalSupport.title: Hospital Support
HospitalSupport.description: Supporting over 15 medical institutions across Ukraine.

post-text.event_description: Our foundation provides assistance to hospitals, ensuring they have the essential supplies for functioning. More than 15 medical institutions across Ukraine have already received our support.
event_highlights: Provided diapers, swaddles, and other hygiene supplies.
Delivered medicines and vitamins to hospitals.
Supplied necessary medical equipment for healthcare institutions.
event_effects: Improved patient care conditions in hospitals.
Ensured stable operation of medical facilities.
Raised awareness of medical support needs during the war.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to @stelp_supporter_on_site for helping us support hospitals. Together, we are strong! 💙💛

AnimalSupport.alt: A volunteer holds a puppy at the Sirius shelter
AnimalSupport.title: Animal Support
AnimalSupport.description: Supporting the Sirius shelter, home to over 3000 dogs.

post-text.event_description: Our team continues to support animals. This time, we delivered 700 kg of meat to the Sirius shelter, which houses over 3000 stray dogs.
event_highlights: Delivered 700 kg of meat for the animals.
Supported over 3000 dogs residing in the Sirius shelter.
Improved food conditions for animals at the shelter.
event_effects: Enhanced nutrition for animals in Ukraine's largest shelter.
Continued systematic support for animal shelters.
Raised awareness about the importance of helping stray animals.
post-text.event_thanks: Heartfelt thanks to everyone who supports our furry friends. Together, we are strong! 💙💛

MutualAidProject.alt: Fund volunteers and soldiers of the special unit in a group photo outdoors
MutualAidProject.title: Mutual Aid Project
MutualAidProject.description: Supporting the Armed Forces special unit and self-defense training for volunteers.

post-text.event_title: Mutual Aid Project with the Armed Forces
post-text.event_description: As part of the mutual aid project, we provided the Armed Forces special unit with essentials such as food, blankets, power banks, and more. In return, they conducted a self-defense course for our volunteers.
event_highlights: Delivered food, blankets, power banks, and other necessities to the special unit.
Hosted a professional self-defense course for the foundation's volunteers.
Fostered collaboration between volunteers and the military for a common cause.
event_effects: Enhanced support for the Armed Forces special unit with essential resources.
Improved safety and awareness among volunteers.
Established a unique mutual aid format uniting military and civilian initiatives.
post-text.event_thanks: Thank you to our defenders for their help and collaboration! Together, we are strong! 💙💛

ALLSTARSIT.alt: Children and volunteers laugh and dance at the “Gift a Holiday to Children” party
ALLSTARSIT.title: ALLSTARSIT
ALLSTARSIT.description: Partnering with ALLSTARSIT to expand humanitarian aid across Ukraine.

post-text.event_description: This partnership enabled us to extend our reach and help thousands more in need. Together, we organized a charity event, “Gift a Holiday to Children”, to support orphans, displaced children, and those who lost parents during the war.
event_highlights: Hosted a “Plaster Figurine Painting” master class.
Ran a “String Art” workshop.
Featured performances by Ukrainian boy band D-side Band and Amador Lopez, a singer and choreographer from Rumbero’s.
Organized a “Paw Patrol” puppet show.
Set up beauty bars, giant designer coloring books, and fun photobooths.
Provided children with gifts such as plush toys, pillows, blankets, and gingerbread cookies.
Offered treats like cotton candy, hot dogs, juices, and doughnuts from GastroFamily Market.
Ensured access to free sparkling and still water courtesy of Morshynska.
event_effects: Brought joy to children affected by war, offering a safe space for creativity and celebration.
Distributed essential items to over 300 children, including orphans and displaced kids.
Made a lasting positive impact on families in need.
post-text.event_thanks: A heartfelt thanks to ALLSTARSIT for their collaboration and to our partners Morshynska, GastroFamily Market, Kiwi Party, and the Kyiv Police for helping us bring this event to life. Together, we are strong!

STELP.alt: Children play with colorful soft cubes at a holiday party next to a Christmas tree
STELP.title: STELP Event
STELP.description: Assistance for IDPs, hospitals, and military units, thanks to STELP's funding.

post-text.event_title: Together We Made Power: Helping People in Ukraine
post-text.event_description: Since the first days of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, we have tirelessly worked to provide aid to those most affected by the crisis. Thanks to STELP's funding, we have made incredible progress.
event_highlights: Distributed €10,000 worth of winter clothing to 480 children, including those who are disabled or orphaned.
Delivered 500 food boxes, each containing 17 kilograms of essential supplies.
Prepared 127 baby boxes with necessary items for children aged 0–5 years.
Organized a celebration for 80 children who lost families or are living with disabilities, providing warm blankets, toys, and treats.
Hosted a holiday celebration where children participated in drawing, singing, and contests with animators from @kiwi_party_.
event_effects: Supported over 1,000 children and families in need.
Brought positivity, hope, and smiles to vulnerable communities.
Created lasting memories for children during difficult times.
post-text.event_thanks: We extend our heartfelt thanks to STELP for their continued support and collaboration, as well as to our partners @kiwi_party_, @gfmarket.ukraine, @avtosojuz, and @cossack.nation.ua for their contributions. Together, we are making a difference!

WCKitchen.alt: Humanitarian aid banners of GRP Help and the fund, with World Central Kitchen logos
WCKitchen.title: Partnership with WCKitchen
WCKitchen.description: Providing aid to internally displaced persons through food packages from our partners at WCKitchen.

post-text.event_title: Together We Made Power: Helping IDPs with WCKitchen
post-text.event_description: Volunteer work is hard labor, driven by the initiative of volunteers, a shared spirit of victory, and the sincere gratitude of the people we help. Thanks to our partnership with WCKitchen, we established a food package distribution point for IDPs.
event_highlights: Distributed 12 tons of humanitarian aid in 8 days.
Provided 1,100 food packages to IDPs, each weighing 11 kg.
Organized a temporary offline hub in Kyiv to facilitate distribution.
event_effects: Delivered food packages to over 1,100 displaced persons.
Supported those in greatest need.
Fostered a spirit of volunteerism within the community.
post-text.event_thanks: Special thanks to our partners: WCKitchen for the food packages and @grp.help for organizational and media support. Together, we are strong!

about.title: Empowering Communities, Changing Lives
about.description: The TWMP Foundation helps children: children displaced from other regions, children with disabilities and other difficulties, and the single mothers raising them. We also help animal shelters.
about.support: Supported over 10,900 internally displaced persons with housing, food, and medical supplies.
about.projects: Initiated over 100 community projects to foster growth and resilience.
about.partnerships: Collaborated with 50+ organizations to amplify the impact of our efforts.
about.vision: Our vision is a world where everyone has the tools and opportunities to thrive.
about.footer: Together, we are building a brighter future for everyone.
